name: shiori

scripts.build:showcase: pnpm --filter shiori-desktop exec vite build --config renderer/vite.showcase.config.ts
scripts.showcase:preview: pnpm --filter shiori-desktop exec vite preview --config renderer/vite.showcase.config.ts
scripts.//lint: Run from the repository root, not through --filter: ESLint takes the lintable area from the working directory, so an apps/desktop-rooted run cannot reach plugins/*/{ui,surface}/. See eslint.config.js.
scripts.lint: eslint apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/renderer/src apps/desktop/showcase apps/desktop/tests/integration apps/desktop/tests/plugin-ui/packaged*.ts tests/fixtures/external-plugin/src plugins

//devDependencies: The react entries above are the host renderer's UI runtime, declared at the workspace root because colocated plugin UI (`plugins/<id>/{ui,surface}/`) is compiled into that renderer's bundle (#174) while living outside `apps/desktop/`. A bare `react` import there — including the `react/jsx-runtime` import that `jsx: react-jsx` emits for every .tsx file — cannot be resolved by walking up from the importing file. Vite's build resolves it from the Vite root regardless, but `tsc` and the `tsx` test runner do not, so plugin UI would ship unchecked and untestable. Keep these ranges identical to apps/desktop/package.json: pnpm then resolves both to one store entry, so there is a single React instance.
